title: Synthesis of nanoscale surfactant-encapsulated silica-supported polyoxometalate [Si/AlO2]@[PWZn]@CTAB and its catalytic application in the oxidation of alcohols
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,8777-8783
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA00821B, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Mohammad Alizadeh, Bahram Yadollahi
Surfactant-encapsulated silica-supported polyoxometalates [Si/AlO2]@[PWM]@CTAB (M = Cr, Mn, Fe, Co, Ni, Cu and Zn) have been synthesized and after characterization used as heterogeneous catalysts in the oxidation of various alcohols.
